allocation_impact: Charged per sector from the tile count and each tile's control word before the tile list or item list is reserved; bounds decoded memory, which the raw-byte limits do not (one raw byte can decode to a whole entry).
boundary_tests: a bundle decoding to exactly the budget is accepted
the sector that takes the total over the budget is rejected before its tiles are reserved
notes: MAP-BUNDLE-1a; ADR-0021 §4.2 and §4.8; format document §9. Initial value; MAP-BUNDLE-1b confirms it on the real map. Source map about 19.37 M tiles.
resource: Decoded tiles of one bundle, over all sectors
